description: Hide one of your listings from the marketplace without deleting it (visible: false), or bring it back (visible: true). Hiding is instant and keeps the listing, its stats and existing orders; hidden listings cannot be found or bought. Making it visible again sends it through moderation, so it shows as pending until approved, and a paid listing needs a payout wallet. Listings hidden by the iamai.markets team cannot be re-published. Use delete_listing to remove a listing for good. Needs your API key.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.

id.description: Id of a listing you own: the id from create_listing or the listings in my_account

visible.description: false = hide it now; true = publish it again (after moderation)

name: set_listing_visibility
title: Hide or show a listing
